extracted.intended_audience: public company registrants, corporate secretaries, compensation committees, and securities counsel preparing proxy statements, Form 10-Ks, and other SEC filings
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and disclosure requirements under Regulation S‑K Items 402 (executive compensation/pay versus performance and related disclosures), 403 (security ownership), and 404 (related‑person transactions). Guidance covers required tables, calculations, footnotes, exemptions, filing formats, and specific thresholds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emerging growth company exemption for Item 402(u)
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant is not required to comply with paragraph (u) of this Item if it is an emerging growth company as defined in Section 2(a)(19) of the Securities Act or Section 3(a)(80) of the Exchange Act; a registrant must comply with paragraph (u) for the first fiscal year commencing on or after the date it ceases to be an emerging growth company, but not for any fiscal year commencing before January 1, 2017.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional information prominence and identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Registrants may present additional information, including additional ratios, to supplement the required ratio, but are not required to do so.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any additional information shall be clearly identified, not misleading, and not presented with greater prominence than the required ratio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple PEOs: permissible calculation methods
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant with more than one non-concurrent PEO during its fiscal year may calculate the annual total compensation for its PEO either by (1) calculating compensation provided to each person who served as PEO during the year for the time he or she served and combining those figures, or (2) looking to the PEO serving in that position on the date it selects to identify the median employee and annualizing that PEO's compensation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regardless of alternative selected, the registrant shall disclose which option it chose and how it calculated its PEO's annual total compensation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect personally identifiable information about identified employee
rubrics_metrics.description: Registrants are not required to, and should not, disclose any personally identifiable information about the identified employee other than his or her compensation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrants may choose to generally identify an employee's position to put the employee's compensation in context, but should not do so if providing the information could identify any specific individual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table fiscal year labeling
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the applicable fiscal year in the title to each table required under this Item which calls for disclosure as of or for a completed fiscal year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pay Versus Performance: time horizon for table
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the Pay Versus Performance table for each of the registrant's last five completed fiscal years (subject to smaller reporting company exceptions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Smaller reporting companies may provide the information for three years instead of five (with transitional rules for first-time filers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pay Versus Performance: required tabular columns
rubrics_metrics.description: The Pay Versus Performance table must include columns for: (a) fiscal year; (b) Summary compensation table total for PEO; (c) Compensation actually paid to PEO; (d) Average summary compensation table total for non-PEO named executive officers; (e) Average compensation actually paid to non-PEO named executive officers; (f) Value of initial fixed $100 investment based on registrant's cumulative total shareholder return; (g) Value of initial fixed $100 investment based on peer group cumulative total shareholder return; (h) Registrant's net income; (i) Company-Selected Measure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each column must be provided for each fiscal year included in the table. If more than one PEO served, provide separate columns for each PEO where specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Column (b) — PEO total compensation (Summary Compensation Table)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose the PEO's total compensation for the covered fiscal year as reported in the Summary Compensation Table (or smaller reporting company equivalent), and the average total compensation reported for the remaining named executive officers collectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If more than one person served as PEO during the covered fiscal year, provide the total compensation for each person separately in additional column(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Columns (c) and (e) — executive compensation actually paid (calculation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Executive compensation actually paid must be the total compensation for the covered fiscal year as provided in the Summary Compensation Table (or smaller reporting company equivalent), adjusted as specified in paragraph (v)(2)(iii).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjustments include deductions for aggregate change in actuarial present value of accumulated benefits, additions for service cost and prior service cost, and adjustments for equity and option awards as specified in (v)(2)(iii)(C).

rubrics_metrics.name: Deduct aggregate change in actuarial present value of pension benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: Deduct the aggregate change in the actuarial present value of the named executive officer's accumulated benefit under all defined benefit and actuarial pension plans reported in the Summary Compensation Table pursuant to paragraph (c)(2)(viii)(A) of this section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add service cost and prior service cost for pensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Add, for all defined benefit and actuarial pension plans reported, the aggregate of (i) service cost (actuarial present value of benefit attributable to services rendered during the covered fiscal year) and (ii) prior service cost (entire cost of benefits granted or credited in a plan amendment during the covered fiscal year that are attributed by the benefit formula to services rendered in periods prior to the amendment).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Service cost and prior service cost must be calculated using the same methodology as used for the registrant's financial statements under generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP).

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity and option award fair value adjustments (v)(2)(iii)(C) — elements
rubrics_metrics.description: For all stock awards and all option awards (with or without tandem SARs), include adjustments that: (i) add fair value as of end of covered fiscal year of awards granted during the year that are outstanding and unvested at year end; (ii) add change in fair value (end of year vs end of prior year) of awards granted in prior years that remain outstanding and unvested; (iii) add fair value as of vesting date for awards granted and vesting in same year; (iv) add change in fair value as of vesting date (vs end of prior fiscal year) for awards granted in prior fiscal years that vest during the year; (v) subtract fair value at end of prior fiscal year for awards granted in prior years that fail to vest during the covered fiscal year; (vi) add dollar value of dividends or other earnings on awards paid prior to vesting that are not otherwise included in total compensation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These adjustments apply to awards that subsequently have been transferred as well.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adjustments for modified or amended options/SARs
rubrics_metrics.description: If the registrant adjusted or amended the exercise price of options or SARs (through amendment, cancellation, replacement grants, or other means) or materially modified such awards during the fiscal year, the changes in fair value included must take into account the excess fair value, if any, of any such modified award over the fair value of the original award as of the date of such modification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fair value computation consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: Fair value amounts must be computed in a manner consistent with the fair value methodology used to account for share-based payments in the registrant's financial statements under GAAP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For awards subject to performance conditions, calculate change in fair value as of end of fiscal year based upon the probable outcome of such conditions as of the last day of the fiscal year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Columns (f) and (g) — cumulative total shareholder return calculation
rubrics_metrics.description: For each fiscal year, disclose the registrant's cumulative total shareholder return (column f) and peer group cumulative total shareholder return (column g) calculated in the same manner as under § 229.201(e) (Item 201(e)): measurement period begins at the market close on the last trading day before the registrant's earliest fiscal year in the table through the end of each fiscal year; convert closing price at measurement point into a fixed $100 investment; report the value of that fixed investment as of each year end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the same methodology for both registrant and peer group. Returns of each peer group component must be weighted by market capitalization at the beginning of each period. If peer group is not a published index, disclose identity of issuers in a footnote. If peer group selection changes year-to-year, explain reasons in footnote and compare returns with both the new and prior peer groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Column (h) — registrant net income
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose the registrant's net income for each fiscal year (column h).

rubrics_metrics.name: Column (i) — Company-Selected Measure
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose an amount for each fiscal year attributable to an additional financial performance measure (Company-Selected Measure) that the registrant assesses as the most important financial performance measure used to link compensation actually paid to named executive officers for the most recently completed fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial performance measures are measures determined and presented in accordance with accounting principles used in preparing the issuer's financial statements, measures derived from such measures, and stock price and total shareholder return. A Company-Selected Measure need not be presented within the registrant's financial statements. If the Company-Selected Measure is not a financial measure under GAAP, the disclosure is not subject to Regulation G and Item 10(e), but registrant must disclose how the number is calculated from audited financial statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Footnote disclosure for amounts in columns (c) and (e)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each amount disclosed in columns (c) and (e), disclose in footnotes to the table each of the amounts deducted and added pursuant to paragraph (v)(2)(iii), the name of each named executive officer included as a PEO or in the calculation of the average remaining named executive officer compensation, and the fiscal years in which such persons are included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For disclosure of executive compensation actually paid to named executive officers other than the PEO, provide the amounts required as averages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Footnote assumptions for equity valuation
rubrics_metrics.description: For the value of equity awards added pursuant to paragraph (v)(2)(iii)(C), disclose in a footnote any assumption made in the valuation that differs materially from those disclosed as of the grant date of such equity awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative/graphic description of relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the information in the Pay Versus Performance table to provide a clear description (graphically, narratively, or both) of the relationships across the last five completed fiscal years between (i) executive compensation actually paid to the PEO and average compensation actually paid to other named executive officers and (ii) (A) cumulative TSR of the registrant, (B) net income, and (C) the Company-Selected Measure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a comparison of the registrant's cumulative TSR and peer group cumulative TSR over the same period. If additional measures are provided, each must be accompanied by a clear description of the relationship between compensation actually paid and that measure across the last five fiscal years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tabular List of financial performance measures (v)(6)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a tabular list of at least three, and up to seven, financial performance measures that the registrant assesses represent the most important measures used to link compensation actually paid to named executive officers for the most recently completed fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrant may provide one list, two separate lists (one for PEO and one for other NEOs), or separate lists for PEO and each other named executive officer. If fewer than three financial performance measures were used, include all such measures. Registrant may include non-financial measures in the Tabular List if they are among its three to seven most important measures, but must have disclosed its most important three (or fewer) financial performance measures. Maximum seven measures applies regardless of inclusion of non-financial measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive Data File requirement for paragraph (v) and related disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: The disclosure provided pursuant to paragraph (v), including paragraph (v)(3) and (6), must appear with and in the same format as the rest of the disclosure required by this section and must be provided in an Interactive Data File in accordance with § 232.405 and the EDGAR Filer Manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smaller reporting company relief for Pay Versus Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant that qualifies as a smaller reporting company may provide the Pay Versus Performance information for three years instead of five; in its first filing may provide only two years and is not required to provide peer group TSR, Company-Selected Measure disclosure, or the Tabular List. For certain calculations, smaller reporting companies use the smaller reporting company Summary Compensation Table references and must disclose adjustments in footnotes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A smaller reporting company is required to comply with the Interactive Data File requirement in the third filing in which it provides the paragraph (v) disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transitional relief for first-time Pay Versus Performance filers
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant may provide the disclosure required by paragraph (v) for three years instead of five in the first filing in which it provides this disclosure, and may provide disclosure for an additional year in each of the two subsequent annual filings in which the disclosure is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: New registrant availability exception
rubrics_metrics.description: Information for fiscal years prior to the last completed fiscal year will not be required if the registrant was not required to report under Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Exchange Act at any time during that year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-incorporation by reference of paragraph (v) disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The information required by paragraph (v) will not be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act or Exchange Act except to the extent the registrant specifically incorporates it by reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clawback disclosure when restatement requires recovery (Item 402(w)(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: If the registrant was required to prepare an accounting restatement that required recovery of erroneously awarded compensation pursuant to the registrant's compensation recovery policy, or if there was an outstanding balance as of the end of the last completed fiscal year, the registrant must disclose specified information for each restatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required information for each restatement includes: (A) date of restatement; (B) aggregate dollar amount of erroneously awarded compensation attributable to the restatement, including analysis of how calculated; (C) if the financial reporting measure related to stock price/TSR, the estimates and methodology used to determine the erroneously awarded compensation; (D) aggregate dollar amount outstanding at end of last fiscal year; (E) if aggregate amount not yet determined, disclose this fact, explain reasons, and disclose required information in the next required filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clawback disclosure when recovery impracticable
rubrics_metrics.description: If recovery would be impracticable pursuant to 17 CFR 240.10D-1(b)(1)(iv), disclose for each current and former named executive officer and for all other current and former executive officers as a group the amount of recovery forgone and a brief description of the reason the registrant decided not to pursue recovery in each case.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clawback disclosure for long-outstanding balances (180 days)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each current and former named executive officer from whom, as of the end of the last completed fiscal year, erroneously awarded compensation had been outstanding for 180 days or longer since the date the registrant determined the amount owed, disclose the dollar amount of outstanding erroneously awarded compensation due from each such individual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanation when recovery not required by policy
rubrics_metrics.description: If the registrant concluded that recovery of erroneously awarded compensation was not required pursuant to its compensation recovery policy, briefly explain why application of the recovery policy resulted in that conclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clawback disclosure presentation and Interactive Data requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The clawback-related information must appear with, and in the same format as, the rest of the Item 402 disclosure and in the registrant's Form 10-K, and must be provided in an Interactive Data File in accordance with Rule 405 of Regulation S-T and the EDGAR Filer Manual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The information will not be deemed incorporated by reference into other filings except to the extent specifically incorporated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policies/practices on timing of equity awards near material nonpublic information
rubrics_metrics.description: Discuss registrant's policies and practices on timing of awards of options in relation to the disclosure of material nonpublic information, including how the board determines when to grant such awards (e.g., whether grants are on a predetermined schedule); whether the board or compensation committee takes material nonpublic information into account when determining timing/terms and, if so, how; and whether the registrant has timed the disclosure of material nonpublic information for the purpose of affecting the value of executive compensation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of awards granted close in time to disclosure (table and timing window)
rubrics_metrics.description: If during the last completed fiscal year the registrant awarded options to a named executive officer in the period beginning four business days before the filing of a periodic report on Form 10-Q or Form 10-K, or the filing/furnishing of an 8‑K that discloses material nonpublic information, and ending one business day after the filing/furnishing, provide a table concerning each such award for each named executive officer (Table 13).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The table must include per-award details specified in paragraph (x)(2)(ii).

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 13 required columns for close-in-time awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Table columns must include: (a) Name of named executive officer; (b) Grant date; (c) Number of securities underlying the award; (d) Exercise price per share; (e) Grant date fair value computed using same methodology as used in registrant's financial statements under GAAP; (f) Percentage change in closing market price of underlying securities between trading day ending immediately prior to disclosure and trading day beginning immediately following the disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smaller reporting company / emerging growth company limitation for close-in-time awards
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant that is a smaller reporting company or emerging growth company may limit the Table 13 disclosures to its PEO, the two most highly compensated executive officers other than the PEO who were serving as executive officers at the end of the last completed fiscal year, and up to two additional individuals who would have been the most highly compensated but were not serving as executive officers at the end of the last completed fiscal year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive Data File requirement for paragraph (x) disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: The disclosure provided pursuant to paragraph (x) must be provided in an Interactive Data File as required by 17 CFR 232.405 in accordance with the EDGAR Filer Manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 403 — beneficial ownership disclosure for >5% holders
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish, as of the most recent practicable date, substantially in the tabular form indicated, information with respect to any person known to the registrant to be the beneficial owner of more than five percent of any class of the registrant's voting securities: title of class; name and address of beneficial owner; amount and nature of beneficial ownership; percent of class.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate by footnote or otherwise the amount known to be shares with respect to which such owner has right to acquire beneficial ownership as specified in Rule 13d-3(d)(1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 403 — management beneficial ownership table
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish, as of the most recent practicable date, substantially in the tabular form indicated, for each class of equity securities: each director and nominee (naming them), each named executive officer as defined in Item 402(a)(3), and directors and executive officers as a group (without naming them): title of class; name of beneficial owner; amount and nature of beneficial ownership; percent of class.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate shares pledged as security and shares with respect to which such persons have right to acquire beneficial ownership as specified in §240.13d-3(d)(1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 403 — changes in control disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any arrangements, known to the registrant, including any pledge by any person of securities of the registrant or any of its parents, the operation of which may at a subsequent date result in a change in control of the registrant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 403 instruction: percentage calculation and asterisk option
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentages are to be calculated on the basis of the amount of outstanding securities, excluding securities held by or for the account of the registrant or its subsidiaries, plus securities deemed outstanding pursuant to Rule 13d-3(d)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For paragraph (b), if percentage of shares beneficially owned by any director/nominee or group does not exceed one percent, registrant may indicate this fact by means of an asterisk and explanatory footnote or similar means.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 403 instruction: determination of beneficial ownership
rubrics_metrics.description: For purposes of Item 403, beneficial ownership shall be determined in accordance with Rule 13d-3 under the Exchange Act (§240.13d-3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include additional subcolumns or appropriate explanation to reflect amounts as to which beneficial owner has sole voting power, shared voting power, sole investment power, or shared investment power.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 403 instruction: reliance on filed 13(d)/13(g) statements
rubrics_metrics.description: The registrant shall be deemed to know the contents of any statements filed with the Commission pursuant to section 13(d) or 13(g).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When applicable, a registrant may rely upon information set forth in such statements unless the registrant knows or has reason to believe that such information is not complete or accurate or that a statement or amendment should have been filed and was not.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 403 instruction: avoid confusion when multiple beneficial owners listed
rubrics_metrics.description: Where more than one beneficial owner is known to be listed for the same securities, appropriate disclosure should be made to avoid confusion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In computing aggregate number of shares owned by directors and officers as a group, the same shares shall not be counted more than once.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 403 instruction: voting trust disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Where holders of voting securities reported pursuant to paragraph (a) hold more than five percent pursuant to any voting trust or similar agreement, state the title of such securities, the amount held or to be held pursuant to the trust or agreement (if not clear), and the duration of the agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give names and addresses of the voting trustees and outline briefly their voting rights and other powers under the trust or agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 404(a) — threshold and scope for related‑person transactions
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any transaction since the beginning of the registrant's last fiscal year, or any currently proposed transaction, in which the registrant was or is to be a participant and the amount involved exceeds $120,000, and in which any related person had or will have a direct or indirect material interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required disclosure must address the elements listed in Item 404(a)(1)–(6).

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 404(a) — required disclosures for each related‑person transaction
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose for each such transaction: (1) name of the related person and basis on which the person is related; (2) the related person's interest in the transaction (positions/relationships/ownership in firms that are party or have an interest); (3) approximate dollar value of the amount involved in the transaction; (4) approximate dollar value of the amount of the related person's interest in the transaction (computed without regard to profit or loss); (5) in case of indebtedness, disclosure must include the largest aggregate amount of principal outstanding during the period for which disclosure is provided, amount outstanding as of latest practicable date, amount of principal paid during the periods for which disclosure is provided, amount of interest paid during the period, and rate or amount of interest payable; (6) any other information regarding the transaction or related person that is material to investors in light of the circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 404 instructions — definition of related person
rubrics_metrics.description: For purposes of Item 404(a), 'related person' means: (a) any person who was at any time during the specified period a director or executive officer of the registrant; any nominee for director when the information is presented in a proxy/information statement relating to election of that nominee; or any immediate family member of a director, executive officer or nominee (list of family members provided); and (b) any person who was in certain categories when a transaction occurred (a security holder covered by Item 403(a) or any immediate family member of such a security holder).

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 404 instruction: scope of 'transaction'
rubrics_metrics.description: For purposes of paragraph (a), a transaction includes, but is not limited to, any financial transaction, arrangement or relationship (including any indebtedness or guarantee of indebtedness) or any series of similar transactions, arrangements or relationships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 404 instruction: computation of amount involved (leases and periodic payments)
rubrics_metrics.description: The amount involved in the transaction shall be computed by determining the dollar value of the amount involved, which includes, for leases or other transactions providing for periodic payments or installments, the aggregate amount of all periodic payments or installments due on or after the beginning of the registrant's last fiscal year, including any required or optional payments due during or at the conclusion of the lease or transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 404 instruction: computation of amount involved (indebtedness)
rubrics_metrics.description: In the case of indebtedness, compute the amount involved as the largest aggregate amount of all indebtedness outstanding at any time since the beginning of the registrant's last fiscal year and all amounts of interest payable on it during the last fiscal year.
